text: Hi guys, thank you so much. The amount of support I received from you has been incredible. Of course, I still got some threats, insults and other things, but honestly, that's just a drop in the ocean compared to all the positivity and kind words I've seen from you. I read your comments, I read your messages, I just rarely reply, because there are so many of them. So I wanted to make this video to say thank you to all of you. Yes, unfortunately Brenna declined my proposal, but she continues to call my videos a lie. Well, it is what it is. I also got several messages and saw a comment saying that she threatened to sue me for defamation and hiring people to send her negative messages. I find it a little hard to believe, but who knows, maybe it's true. I guess I need to start saving some money for a lawyer. I heard they are not cheap nowadays. But guys, once again, I urge you not to write anything nasty to her, and that is why I also do not want to attack her anymore, even though it is a chicken move. Now I still have a dilemma whether or not I should continue with my analysis of her other studies. On the one hand, she declined the bet, so there is not much point continuing the discussion. On the other hand, she keeps calling my videos a lie, so it might still be worth going through the rest of the studies and checking whether they actually support her original claim. Anyways, I would need to decide on that later, but I can tell you this, even if I continue with the videos on this topic, I will try to stay objective. And by the way, among all the negative comments I receive, sometimes there is a thoughtful critique of my logic or statements that I made. For example, there was a comment that I unfortunately couldn't find to attach here that said something along those lines, that from the perspective of conflating SA and RAPE, her example of using the study on RAPE to support SA claim is justifiable, because RAPE is a subset of SA, and if it would be the other way around, then that would be wrong. Basically alluding to the point that her conflating those terms there doesn't give me a right to conflate those terms in general. Look, fair point. Context matters though. If you watch both of my videos, I was quite careful with using the right terms, and to my knowledge, the only place that I sort of slipped was in the end of my original video where I said, and I hope you guys now can understand better, how some influencers manipulate and misinterpret studies to make ridiculous claims like more than 62 million men in the US RAPE women sound based and factual. To be precise, I should have used SA instead of RAPE. But again, exactly in this video, we were specifically discussing a study that used the term RAPE, which was then used to support a broader claim about SA. So that context can at least partly justify the warning. The point is, guys, I am not perfect either. I have my own biases, and I can make mistakes too. That is why I say I will try to be objective. And that is also why you shouldn't blindly trust any information, including mine. Use your own critical thinking, question things, and double-check what you hear. Especially today. Once again, guys, thanks a lot for your support. See you in the next videos.
